  "phoneNote": "The arched salon photos and restrained palette work well, but the location is buried near the bottom and loose hero spacing delays the imagery.",

    "Add a compact location line beneath the hero description on both screens, so visitors see the salon's location before the booking or pricing action.",
    "Reduce desktop headline sizes and section padding, especially in the hours and team sections; tighten the phone hero gaps to bring the photos higher.",
    "Combine pricing and service descriptions into one structured list, using five balanced columns on desktop and compact rows on phone instead of leaving the fifth price isolated."
